newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Stuck for a Valentine gift? How about a cow.
newsitem.headline: Stuck for a Valentine gift? How about a cow.

text.p: Stuck for what to buy your loved one on Valentine's Day? One idea that may not immediately spring to mind is a part share in a cow.

But the thought has occurred to a Belgian group that has set up an Internet site (http://www.gift.be) listing hundreds of ideas for gifts for men and women ranging from the richest to the poorest, the jet set to the couch potato.

Most are fairly mundane -- watches, champagne, chocolates, fitness courses, cooking utensils or CDs for her, binoculars, a razor, cognac, a toaster or a trip in a chauffeur-driven Rolls-Royce for him.
But the one-tenth share in a cow stands out, although quite how a woman might receive this token of esteem from a man must be open to question.
